page_label: 说　明　书 6/9 页

paragraphs.zh: 将35g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.8％、0.102mol)，21.41g碳酸钾(99％、0.153mol)，1g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.008mol)，200ml  DMF，15.46g2,2,2-三氟乙醇(99％、0.153mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在70～75℃进行反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完毕后过滤，滤液浓缩。往剩余物里4.53g氢氧化钠(99％、0.112mol)，200ml水，在70～75℃进行碱解，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后滴加盐酸酸化，过滤，洗涤，烘干得31.82g白色粉末，纯度99.8％，收率89.6％。
paragraphs.en: 35 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (99.8%, 0.102 mol), 21.41 g of potassium carbonate (99%, 0.153 mol), 1 g of triethylenediamine (99%, 0.008 mol), 200 ml of DMF and 15.46 g of 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol (99%, 0.153 mol) are charged into a 500 ml reaction flask and reacted at 70 to 75 degrees C, followed by LC until the reaction is complete; when the reaction is finished the mixture is filtered and the filtrate is concentrated. Into the residue [are added] 4.53 g of sodium hydroxide (99%, 0.112 mol) and 200 ml of water, and alkaline hydrolysis is carried out at 70 to 75 degrees C, followed by LC until the reaction is complete; when the reaction is complete hydrochloric acid is added dropwise to acidify, and the product is filtered, washed and oven-dried to give 31.82 g of a white powder, purity 99.8%, yield 89.6%.
paragraphs.notes: PROVENANCE CONVENTION FOR THIS WHOLE PAGE. CN109678767A is born digital and every page carries a real embedded text layer. Every zh field on this page was extracted verbatim from that embedded text layer, character for character, and was NOT read off pixels by a vision model. The rendered image was used only for layout (header, footer, marker positions, where each drawing sits) and for the two drawings, which have no text-layer representation at all. A later reader can therefore treat the zh characters here as publisher-supplied rather than model-transcribed, and the drawings as the only model-read content. Nothing has been normalised: the U+00A0 no-break spaces the publisher inserts after a mass figure (35g<NBSP> 2-, 200ml<NBSP> DMF) are preserved as printed, as is the missing space in 15.46g2,2,2-三氟乙醇. Text-layer line wraps are joined with no inserted character, which is correct for Chinese prose. PARAGRAPH-SPECIFIC. This is the procedure body for step 2 of Example 2, whose heading and drawing sit on the preceding page (p07, which ends at the empty marker [0053]); the paragraph itself begins and ends on this page. GRAMMAR: 往剩余物里4.53g氢氧化钠... has no verb - the 加入 (add) the construction requires is simply absent from the publication. Translated with the missing verb bracketed; nothing inserted into zh. 三乙烯二胺 is triethylenediamine, i.e. DABCO (1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane); translated literally as printed. ARITHMETIC CROSS-CHECK (sanity only, no printed figure altered): all five charge figures reconcile with their stated purities and molecular weights to within rounding, and 31.82g at 99.8% against a 0.102mol input gives 89.5%, against the printed 89.6％.

环磺酮 is the Chinese common name this publication uses for the target throughout. The more usual CNIPA form is 环磺草酮 (as used in e.g. CN104292137A); this publication drops the 草. Both denote tembotrione. Rendered as tembotrione here, and the identification is corroborated by the structure drawn immediately below at [0056], which was read off the drawing vertex by vertex rather than assumed from the name.

Marker printed at the left margin with no text of any kind after it. The slot is occupied by a drawn structure - see drawings[0]. The marker sits level with the vertical middle of the structure, roughly two thirds of the way down it, which is the usual CNIPA placement for a figure paragraph.

paragraphs.zh: 将30g  2-氯-3- (2 ,2 ,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸(99 .8％、0.086mol)，0.3g  DMF(99％、0.004mol)，12.4g氯化亚砜(99％、0.103mol)，100ml二氯乙烷加入250ml反应瓶中，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂。将14.6g  1,3-环己二酮(99％、0.129mol)、100ml二氯甲烷加入反应瓶，在20～25℃滴加21.97g三乙胺(99％、0.215mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全。反应完全后，加入1g丙酮氰醇(95％、0.011mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加乙醇进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得32.63g米黄色结晶粉末，纯度98.1％，收率84.1％。
paragraphs.en: 30 g of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid (99.8%, 0.086 mol), 0.3 g of DMF (99%, 0.004 mol), 12.4 g of thionyl chloride (99%, 0.103 mol) and 100 ml of dichloroethane are charged into a 250 ml reaction flask, the temperature is raised and the mixture is reacted at reflux; when the reaction is finished the solvent is stripped off completely. 14.6 g of 1,3-cyclohexanedione (99%, 0.129 mol) and 100 ml of dichloromethane are charged into the reaction flask, and 21.97 g of triethylamine (99%, 0.215 mol) is added dropwise at 20 to 25 degrees C, followed by LC until the reaction is complete. After the reaction is complete, 1 g of acetone cyanohydrin (95%, 0.011 mol) is added, followed by LC until the reaction is complete; when the reaction is complete water is added for a water wash, the layers are separated, the solvent is stripped completely from the oil layer, ethanol is added for recrystallisation, and the product is filtered and oven-dried to give 32.63 g of a rice-yellow (beige) crystalline powder, purity 98.1%, yield 84.1%.
paragraphs.notes: SPACING: the text layer for this paragraph carries publisher justification whitespace inside chemical names and inside numbers - 3- (2 ,2 ,2-三氟乙氧基) and (99 .8％ - where the neighbouring paragraphs have none. Preserved exactly as extracted; a downstream pass must strip it and must not read '99 .8' as anything other than 99.8, nor '(2 ,2 ,2-' as anything other than the 2,2,2-locant set. REAGENTS read as printed: 氯化亚砜 thionyl chloride; 丙酮氰醇 acetone cyanohydrin (this is the cyanohydrin, NOT 氰基丙酮 cyanoacetone - verified character by character in the text layer); 1,3-环己二酮 given here WITH its 1,3- locant, unlike the bare 环己二酮 seen in some other patents. The prose describes three stages (acid chloride formation, O-acylation of the dione with triethylamine, then cyanide-catalysed rearrangement) but only the final product of that sequence is drawn, at [0056] - see discrepancies. ARITHMETIC CROSS-CHECK (sanity only, no printed figure altered): every charge reconciles with its purity and molecular weight to within rounding, and 32.63g at 98.1% against a 0.086mol input gives 84.3%, against the printed 84.1％.
Example 2 ends with the preceding paragraph [0057]. Example 3 runs from here to the end of the page and beyond.

paragraphs.zh: 本实施例提供一种环磺酮的合成工艺，包括以下步骤：
paragraphs.en: This example provides a process for the synthesis of tembotrione, comprising the following steps:
paragraphs.notes: Ends with the full-width colon '：' as printed. 环磺酮 again, same short form as [0055]. This sentence marks everything that follows as a worked example of the invention, not as prior art.

paragraphs.zh: 1、2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成
paragraphs.notes: Step heading. Names the product as the METHYL ester (苯甲酸甲酯), which matches the H3CO- text label drawn at [0061]. The enumeration mark is the ideographic comma '、' after the step number, as printed.
Marker printed at the left margin with no text after it. The slot is occupied by a drawn structure - see drawings[1]. The marker sits level with the vertical middle of the structure.

paragraphs.zh: 将26.46g  2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.6％、0.1mol)，200ml二氯乙烷，0.174g间氯过氧苯甲酸(99％、0.001mol)，16.88g氢溴酸(48％、0.1mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在50～55℃滴加11.33g双氧水(30％、0.1mol)，滴加完毕后继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后分层，有机层水洗、浓缩，异丙醇进行重结晶、过滤、烘干得31.33g白色粉末，纯度98.0％，收率90％。
paragraphs.en: 26.46 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (99.6%, 0.1 mol), 200 ml of dichloroethane, 0.174 g of m-chloroperoxybenzoic acid (99%, 0.001 mol) and 16.88 g of hydrobromic acid (48%, 0.1 mol) are charged into a 500 ml reaction flask, and 11.33 g of hydrogen peroxide (30%, 0.1 mol) is added dropwise at 50 to 55 degrees C; after the dropwise addition is finished the reaction is continued, followed by LC until the reaction is complete; when the reaction is complete the layers are separated, the organic layer is washed with water and concentrated, isopropanol is used for recrystallisation, and the product is filtered and oven-dried to give 31.33 g of a white powder, purity 98.0%, yield 90%.
paragraphs.notes: 间氯过氧苯甲酸 is m-chloroperoxybenzoic acid (mCPBA), charged at about 1 mol% alongside 48% hydrobromic acid and 30% hydrogen peroxide; read as printed, and the paragraph does not label it a catalyst, it lists it as a charged component. This is a benzylic bromination run oxidatively from HBr/H2O2 rather than from elemental bromine; nothing on this page is being reconciled against any other patent. Note the printed yield is 90％ with no decimal place, unlike the neighbouring 89.6％ and 84.1％; reproduced as printed. ARITHMETIC CROSS-CHECK (sanity only): 31.33g at 98.0% against a 0.1mol input gives 89.9%, against the printed 90％, and the mCPBA, HBr and H2O2 charges each reconcile with their stated purities.

paragraphs.zh: 2、2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成
paragraphs.notes: Last line of body text on the page; the lower roughly 15% of the page is blank apart from the footer page number 8. This is a step heading only - its procedure and its structure fall on the following page (p09). Note this heading prints the trifluoroethoxy fragment tight, (2,2,2-三氟乙氧基), whereas [0057] prints the same fragment with justification spaces, (2 ,2 ,2-三氟乙氧基). Both reproduced verbatim.

structures.position_in_drawing: sole structure; centred in the upper third of the page, level with the marker [0056] at the left margin
structures.core: benzene ring joined through an exocyclic ketone carbonyl (aroyl link) to C2 of a saturated cyclohexane-1,3-dione; two ring systems, one molecule
substituents: C(=O) link to cyclohexane-1,3-dione C2, at benzene C1
H at benzene C5 (vertex drawn bare)
H at benzene C6 (vertex drawn bare)
aroyl (the benzene ring, via the exocyclic C=O) at cyclohexanedione C2
CH2 at cyclohexanedione C4, C5 and C6 (all three vertices drawn bare)
structures.name: 2-[2-chloro-4-(methanesulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl]cyclohexane-1,3-dione (tembotrione)

drawings.notes: Single structure. No arrows, no reagent labels, no yield annotation and no text of any kind inside or beside the drawing. NUMBERING CONVENTION used in the substituents list: the benzene carbon carrying the aroyl bond is called C1 and numbering runs round the ring toward the chlorine. The drawing forces this - the four substituents sit on four contiguous ring vertices, so no other numbering is consistent with the picture. Read vertex by vertex at 5x magnification: the ring is drawn with the aroyl bond entering the upper-left vertex (C1); the next vertex clockwise is the top one and carries a bond up to the text label Cl (C2); the next carries a bond right to the horizontal text label CH2OCH2CF3, with the subscripts printed as 2, 2 and 3 (C3); the next carries a bond down-right to a sulfur drawn with one double-bonded O up-right, one double-bonded O down-left and a CH3 below, i.e. a methanesulfonyl group (C4); the remaining two vertices carry nothing. TAUTOMER, read as drawn and not corrected: the cyclohexanedione is drawn SATURATED - no ring double bond anywhere, no enol OH - with the attachment carbon carrying a plain single bond out to the exocyclic carbonyl and flanked by two C=O, one drawn upward and one drawn downward. Tembotrione is more commonly drawn as the enol tautomer; this publication draws the 2-acyl-1,3-dione keto form. That is a drawing convention rather than a different compound, and it is recorded as drawn. The hydrogen on the attachment carbon is implicit and is not written. presented_as is invention_route because this is the product structure of step 3 of Example 2 (实施例2), a worked example of the invention, not a background or prior-art scheme; the field is set that way even though the drawing is a single structure rather than a multi-step scheme. SMILES supplied only because every atom and every bond is unambiguous at magnification.

structures.position_in_drawing: sole structure; centred in the lower half of the page, level with the marker [0061] at the left margin
structures.name: methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate

drawings.notes: Single structure. No arrows, no reagent labels, no annotation of any kind. Same numbering convention as drawings[0]: the benzene carbon carrying the ester is called C1 and numbering runs toward the chlorine, which the drawing forces because the four substituents occupy four contiguous vertices. Read vertex by vertex at 4x magnification: C1 (upper-left vertex) carries a bond up-left to a carbon bearing a double-bonded O above it and a bond further left to the text label H3CO, so the methyl sits on the ester oxygen and this is a METHYL ESTER, not the free acid and not an acid chloride; C2 (top vertex) carries a bond up to the text label Cl; C3 (upper-right vertex) carries a two-bond zig-zag terminating in the text label Br, i.e. a bromomethyl group with the CH2 drawn as a bare vertex; C4 (lower-right vertex) carries a bond to a sulfur drawn with one double-bonded O above, one double-bonded O below and a CH3 to the right; the bottom and lower-left vertices carry nothing. The structure matches the [0060] heading exactly, including the ester being the methyl one. presented_as is invention_route because this is the step 1 product of Example 3 (实施例3), a worked example of the invention; the field is set that way even though the drawing is a single intermediate structure rather than a multi-step scheme.

discrepancies.what: The final step's prose describes a three-stage reagent sequence but only the finished product is drawn; the acid chloride and the enol ester it passes through appear in the text and nowhere in the picture.
discrepancies.drawing_says: drawings[0] shows only the completed 2-aroylcyclohexane-1,3-dione. There is no acid chloride, no enol ester, no arrow and no reagent label anywhere in or beside the drawing.
discrepancies.text_says: [0057] charges thionyl chloride with catalytic DMF (acid chloride formation), then 1,3-cyclohexanedione with triethylamine (O-acylation to the enol ester), then acetone cyanohydrin (cyanide-catalysed rearrangement to the C-acyl product). Three reagent stages, one drawn structure. A downstream pass must take the step count from the prose, not from the number of drawings.

discrepancies.what: The target is drawn as the keto (2-acyl-1,3-dione) tautomer, while the name in the text carries no tautomer information at all.
discrepancies.drawing_says: drawings[0] is drawn saturated, with two ring C=O, no ring double bond, no enol OH, and an implicit H on the attachment carbon.
discrepancies.text_says: [0055] and [0059] name the product only as 环磺酮 (tembotrione), which fixes the constitution but says nothing about tautomer. Not a conflict, but recorded so a downstream pass generating a canonical structure does not assume the enol form from the name or assume the keto form from the drawing.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text. The Chinese common name for the target is written one character short of the usual form.
discrepancies.drawing_says: drawings[0] read off the picture is the tembotrione skeleton: 2-chloro-4-methanesulfonyl-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl on C2 of cyclohexane-1,3-dione.
discrepancies.text_says: [0055] and [0059] both write 环磺酮. The usual CNIPA form is 环磺草酮. Both denote tembotrione. Recorded as printed and not corrected.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text. The same chemical fragment and the same style of purity figure are printed with and without justification spaces on this one page.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - the disagreement is between two prose passages, not with a drawing.
discrepancies.text_says: [0057] prints 3- (2 ,2 ,2-三氟乙氧基) and (99 .8％, with spaces inside the locant string and inside the number; [0063] prints the same fragment tight as (2,2,2-三氟乙氧基), and [0054] prints 99.8％ tight. Reproduced verbatim in every case. This is CNIPA justification whitespace and carries no chemical meaning.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text. A charging sentence in the second-step procedure has no verb.
discrepancies.text_says: [0054] reads 往剩余物里4.53g氢氧化钠(99％、0.112mol)，200ml水，在70～75℃进行碱解, literally 'into the residue 4.53 g sodium hydroxide, 200 ml water'. The 加入 (add) the construction requires is absent from the publication. The English brackets the missing verb; the Chinese is left exactly as extracted.
